list: Advérbios negativos no início → auxiliar + sujeito: never, rarely, seldom, hardly, no sooner, not only, only when/after.

say: Never have I felt so tired. | Nunca me senti tão cansado.
Not only did she win, but... | Ela não só venceu, como...
Had I known, I'd have called. | Se eu soubesse, teria ligado.

list: make a decision/mistake/effort · do homework/research/your best · take a risk/break · have a look.
Formal × informal: obtain × get · request × ask for · regarding × about.

say: It seems that there may be an issue. | Parece que pode haver um problema.
I'm afraid I can't make it. | Receio que não consiga ir.
Perhaps it would be better to wait. | Talvez fosse melhor esperar.
It was John who called. | Foi o John quem ligou.
What I need is a break. | O que preciso é de uma pausa.
I suggest that he be on time. | Sugiro que ele seja pontual.
